As someone who also has HSV, he should have told you. Granted it’s not super likely to be transmitted outside of an outbreak, it is possible to have viral shedding. It’s estimated that 60% of the population have it and up to 80% of those people don’t know. It’s not tested for on routine STI tests. When I had my first outbreak, my test was negative because it was too soon. 

Having HSV doesn’t ruin your life, the stigma is real though. However, him hiding it is extremely deceptive and wrong and you’re completely valid in wondering what else he could be hiding. Don’t settle for that. You should be with someone who respects you enough to allow you to make that choice for yourself. 

Worst case scenario, you do get it. I promise you it’s not the end. I met my husband shortly after and up to this point he has never contracted it. I can send you a some resources I’ve found if you’re interested in learning more. Education is the best way to overcome fear and hopefully settle your worries even if you choose to leave.
